title: NASA Is Hiring Astronauts — Could You Be Next?
summary:
NASA is looking for new astronauts. Could one of them be you someday?

NASA needs new astronauts for future trips to the Moon and, one day, Mars. But getting picked takes much more than loving space.

To apply, you must be a US citizen with a master's degree in science, technology, engineering, or math. You also need at least three years of work experience in a related job and must pass a health test. Applications close on December 3, 2026.

After that, NASA will read every application. A few people will be asked to come for interviews, and even fewer will be chosen. In 2024, NASA picked just 10 people from more than 8,000 applicants. The new group will be named in late 2027.

The winners will train for two years starting in early 2028, practicing spacewalks, flying spacecraft, and using robotic arms. They will also learn survival skills on land and in water.

NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman says they could walk on the Moon, live at a Moon base, and help get crews ready for Mars.
why_it_matters: If you love space and science, learning now could help you become an astronaut one day.

keywords.explanation: A citizen is a person who legally belongs to a country.
A master's degree is an advanced school degree you earn after finishing college.
Applicants are people who apply for a job or a chance to do something.
A spacewalk is when an astronaut goes outside a spacecraft while floating in space.
A robotic arm is a machine arm that can move and grab things, like a robot's arm.
